thesis: The episode discusses the concept of finding 'true signal' versus false signal when identifying consumer opportunities, noting that this is a difficult science to pursue. It also covers the history of Zynga, its founder Mark Pincus's early career, and the transition of the gaming industry from console and PC to mobile distribution via Facebook.
